(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a __defined functional derivative__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ of BH4 or its __defined derivative or precursor__; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __defined functional derivative__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ of BH4 or its __defined derivative or precursor__, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __defined functional derivative__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ of BH4 or its __defined derivative or precursor__, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specific pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative__ thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a __defined functional derivative__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C12 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C13 alkyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a __defined renin inhibitor, ACE inhibitor or AT1 receptor antagonist__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan (optionally in __the prodrug form of candesartan cilexetil__), eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin.
